events.stem:
Thermodynamic systems are classified based on the exchange of mass and energy with their surroundings.
Which one of the following statements about thermodynamic systems is NOT correct?
(A) A hot drink in a perfectly insulated, sealed flask is an example of an open system.
(B) Water boiling in an open beaker is an example of an open system.
(C) A gas heated in a sealed rigid steel cylinder is an example of a closed system.
(D) A living cell is an example of an open system.

members.name: granite-4.2-8b
members.working:
Thermodynamic system classification: open system exchanges both mass and energy with surroundings; closed system exchanges only energy (no mass); isolated system exchanges neither. Evaluate each statement:
(A) Hot drink in a perfectly insulated, sealed flask: sealed prevents mass exchange; insulated prevents energy exchange (no heat transfer). Thus it is an isolated system, not open. Statement claims open → incorrect.
(B) Water boiling in an open beaker: mass (vapor) leaves, energy (heat) can leave; open → correct.
(C) Gas heated in a sealed rigid steel cylinder: sealed prevents mass exchange; energy can be added via heat (or work), so closed → correct.
(D) Living cell exchanges matter (nutrients, waste) and energy (heat, metabolic heat); open → correct.
Thus the statement that is NOT correct is (A).

members.name: granite-4.2-8b
members.working:
A closed thermodynamic system exchanges energy but not matter with surroundings. An open system exchanges both. Evaluate each option:
(A) A living cell exchanges matter (e.g., gases, nutrients) with surroundings → not closed.
(B) Gas in a sealed rigid steel cylinder: no matter can cross the cylinder wall (closed), energy can be added by heating → closed system.
(C) Water boiling in an open beaker: vapor leaves as matter → open system, not closed.
(D) Hot drink in a perfectly insulated, sealed flask: sealed prevents matter exchange; insulation prevents energy exchange (or at least no net energy flow), so closed.
Thus correct statements are (B) and (D).

members.working: Classify by exchange of matter and energy: (A) A living cell takes in nutrients and releases wastes (matter) and exchanges energy with surroundings → open system, not closed. (B) Gas in a sealed rigid steel cylinder: no matter crosses the boundary, but heat can be exchanged with surroundings (walls conduct heat) → closed system. Correct. (C) Water boiling in an open beaker: vapor escapes (matter exchange) and heat flows → open system. (D) Hot drink in a perfectly insulated, sealed flask: exchanges neither matter nor energy → isolated system, not closed. Hence only (B) is correct.
